question_vi: persist middleware trong Zustand hoạt động như thế nào?
question_en: How does the persist middleware in Zustand work?
answer_html_vi:
Middleware persist từ 'zustand/middleware' serialize state thành JSON, lưu vào storage và rehydrate khi app khởi động.

ts
const useAuthStore = create(
  persist(
    (set) => ({ user: null, theme: 'light', loading: false }),
    {
      name: 'auth-storage',
      partialize: (s) => ({ user: s.user, theme: s.theme }),
      storage: createJSONStorage(() => sessionStorage),
      version: 2,
      migrate: (persistedState, version) =>
        version === 1 ? { ...persistedState, newField: 'default' } : persistedState,
      onRehydrateStorage: () => (state, error) => {
        if (error) console.error('hydration failed', error)
      },
    },
  ),
)
  • name là storage key, bắt buộc.
  • partialize chọn phần state cần lưu — bỏ qua loading/error state cho gọn.
  • storage đổi engine: sessionStorage, hoặc AsyncStorage cho React Native.
  • version + migrate xử lý thay đổi cấu trúc state giữa các bản phát hành.

Lưu ý: persist không deep merge — đổi cấu trúc state mà quên migrate thì rehydrate ra state không hợp lệ.
answer_html_en:
The persist middleware from 'zustand/middleware' serializes state to JSON, saves it to storage, and rehydrates on app startup.

ts
const useAuthStore = create(
  persist(
    (set) => ({ user: null, theme: 'light', loading: false }),
    {
      name: 'auth-storage',
      partialize: (s) => ({ user: s.user, theme: s.theme }),
      storage: createJSONStorage(() => sessionStorage),
      version: 2,
      migrate: (persistedState, version) =>
        version === 1 ? { ...persistedState, newField: 'default' } : persistedState,
      onRehydrateStorage: () => (state, error) => {
        if (error) console.error('hydration failed', error)
      },
    },
  ),
)
  • name is the storage key and is required.
  • partialize picks what to persist — leave out loading/error state.
  • storage swaps the engine: sessionStorage, or AsyncStorage for React Native.
  • version + migrate handle state-shape changes between releases.

Note: persist does not deep merge — change the state shape without a migrate and rehydration produces invalid state.
